text_block_list.text:
To catch this many is a truly wonderful feat.
I'm sure my juniors will be overjoyed.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Ah, some of the juniors already have this one.
Would it be alright if I gave it to another committee member?
choice_data_list: Sure. I've got plenty, want one?
Sure. I've got plenty, would you like one?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Me, with a stuffed animal?
...It wouldn't suit me, would it?"
choice_data_list: That's not true, it looks great on you!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Fufu... You truly are so pure.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Since you went through the effort to win it for me, I shall gratefully accept it as well.
